result.title: Density-Aware Reward Scaling: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reward-Proportional Sampling
result.summary: Reinforcement learning objectives that maximize expected return can concentrate probability mass on a small subset of high-reward outcomes, limiting diversity when multiple distinct solutions are desirable. We introduce Density-Aware Reward Scaling (DARS), a simple reward-processing mechanism that promotes reward-proportional sampling in continuous outcome spaces while retaining standard policy-gradient training. DARS estimates the local density of outcomes within each on-policy rollout group and inversely scales rewards by this density. The method requires no learned density model, auxiliary objective, critic, or modification to the underlying policy-gradient objective. In a controlled multimodal navigation task, DARS-GRPO avoids the single-mode collapse exhibited by GRPO and closely recovers the target mode allocation. Applied to text-to-image prompt adaptation, DARS-GRPO consistently improves image and prompt diversity across datasets, Policy LMs, and reward settings while maintaining good semantic alignment. These results show that density-aware reward scaling provides a lightweight way to improve coverage of diverse high-reward outcomes within existing reinforcement-learning pipelines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DARS：在 on-policy rollout 组内估计结果的局部密度，并按密度反比缩放奖励，从而在不改动策略梯度目标、不引入密度模型或 critic 的情况下实现与奖励成比例的采样；在多模态导航任务中缓解 GRPO 的单模态坍缩，并用于文生图提示适配以提升多样性。
AI.relevance_reason: 组内密度反比奖励缩放这一奖励塑形线索，可能可供核查用于缓解 GRPO 类训练中 latent 推理轨迹模式的坍缩、鼓励多种 latent 假设共存，但其评估仅在导航与图像生成任务上，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。
